recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Sovereign country. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Principality of Andorra. Parliamentary democracy (since march 1993) that retains its chiefs of state in the form of a co-principality; the two princes are the president of france and bishop of seu d'urgell, spain.
rulers: Co-prince Emmanuel MACRON (since 14 May 2017); represented by Patrick STROZDA (since 14 May 2017); and Co-prince Archbishop Joan-Enric VIVES i Sicilia (since 12 May 2003); represented by Eduard Ibanez PULIDO (since 27 November 2023); Prime Minister Xavier Espot ZAMORA (since 16 May 2019)
government: parliamentary democracy (since March 1993) that retains its chiefs of state in the form of a co-principality; the two princes are the President of France and Bishop of Seu d'Urgell, Spain
economy: high GDP; low unemployment; non-EU Euro user; co-principality duty-free area between Spain and France; tourist hub but hit hard by COVID-19; modern, non-tax haven financial sector; looking for big tech investments; new member of SEPA and IMF GDP (PPP): $5.402 billion (2024 est.). note: data in 2021 dollars
military: no regular military forces; Police Corps of Andorra (under the Ministry of Justice and Interior)
origin: 1278 (formed under the joint sovereignty of the French Count of Foix and the Spanish Bishop of Urgell)
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
